dedupe_keys.name: comsof fiber automated fibre network planning and design software iqgeo

description: Comsof Fiber, sold by IQGeo Group, is commercial software that automates the planning and design of fibre-to-the-home and other fibre-optic access networks for telecom operators and engineering firms. The product page says it lets planners compare multiple scenarios and network architectures, reuse existing infrastructure, and apply workflow templates so that design steps can be repeated and changed; IQGeo claims it cuts planning and design time by up to 90 per cent and total build cost by up to 10 per cent. It sits in IQGeo's wider suite for telecom and utility networks, which includes Network Manager Telecom, Electric and Gas and field and inspection applications, and IQGeo reports more than 100,000 active users of its software. Coverage: generic software; customer stories named on the page include Deutsche Telekom and Proximus. Format and access: licensed software with demos, a product sheet and FAQs; sold through sales. Licence: proprietary; terms and prices were not read. Caveats: the savings figures are the vendor's own claims, and the product sheet, input data formats and optimisation method were not read. Simulation uses: optimising fibre access network layouts and costs, and planning redundancy or rebuild of fixed telecom networks. Related records: Forsk Atoll (platform-forsk-atoll) is a commercial planning tool for radio, not fibre networks.
